name: com.gitgram/mcp-server
description: Time travel for AI-assisted development. Checkpoint, restore, and search through your complete development state including files, terminal history, and AI conversations.

environment_variables.name: AITM_EXPERIMENTAL_TOOLS
environment_variables.description: Set to '1' to enable experimental tools

tools.name: before_action
tools.description: Create automatic checkpoint before making file changes

tools.name: after_action
tools.description: Record what was done after completing file changes

tools.name: tm_checkpoint_create
tools.description: Create a checkpoint (snapshot of current state)

tools.name: tm_diff
tools.description: Show diff between two checkpoints or checkpoint and current

tools.name: tm_timeline
tools.description: Get timeline of events for a project

tools.name: tm_bisect
tools.description: Binary search to find when a test started failing
